models_evaluated: Med-KAG (Qwen3-235B-A22B with UMLS knowledge graph retrieval)

links.outcome: MedQA-US accuracy of KG-grounded RAG variant versus baseline LLM
links.effect: Comparable accuracy between baseline Qwen3-235B-A22B and knowledge-enhanced variant; retriever identified as primary source of error.
links.quote: Our preliminary evaluation on MedQA-US compares a baseline large language model (Qwen3-235B-A22B) with its knowledge-enhanced variant, showing comparable accuracy while identifying the retriever as the primary source of error.

screen.reason: Evaluates adding a medical knowledge-augmented generation (RAG with UMLS KG) safeguard to a baseline LLM to ground outputs and reduce hallucinations, tested on the MedQA benchmark.
